title: Bank Holiday in Dehradun: Understanding Igas-Bagwal Closures
description: Bank branches in Dehradun and other parts of Uttarakhand may be closed on specific regional holidays like Igas-Bagwal. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) publish.

faq.q: Are all bank holidays observed nationwide?
faq.a: No, bank holidays in India are categorised into national and regional holidays. While national holidays are observed across the country, regional holidays are specific to certain states or Union Territories, as per the RBI calendar.

faq.q: Can I still use UPI and NEFT on a bank holiday?
faq.a: Yes, Unified Payments Interface (UPI) and National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT) services are generally available 24x7, even on bank holidays. You can initiate and receive funds digitally.

faq.q: What is the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, in relation to bank holidays?
faq.a: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, is the legal framework under which many bank holidays are declared. On days notified under this Act, transactions involving instruments like cheques and promissory notes cannot be processed.

faq.q: How do I know if my specific bank branch is closed for a regional holiday?
faq.a: You should refer to the official RBI holiday calendar available on their website (www.rbi.org.in) or check your specific bank's official website or mobile app for holiday notifications relevant to your region.

faq.q: Does a bank holiday affect ATM services?
faq.a: No, bank holidays typically do not affect ATM services. ATMs continue to be operational for cash withdrawals and other basic transactions, though cash replenishment might be delayed if the holiday extends over several days.

faq.q: What if I need to deposit a cheque on a bank holiday?
faq.a: While physical cheque deposits at branches are not possible on a bank holiday, many banks offer cheque drop-boxes at their ATM locations or branches. However, the cheque will only be processed on the next working day.

fact_check.summary: The article provides a generally reliable overview of bank holidays in India, accurately distinguishing between national and regional holidays and the functioning of digital services. However, it contains a few inaccuracies regarding the 24x7 availability of RTGS and the specific date of the "Banks' Closing of Accounts" holiday.

corrections.note: Corrected the categories of holidays listed on the RBI website and clarified RTGS availability.

edits.why: The RBI website primarily lists holidays under 'Holiday under Negotiable Instruments Act' and 'Banks' Closing of Accounts'. There isn't a separate explicit category for 'Holidays under Negotiable Instruments Act and Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) Holiday' on the RBI's holiday page. RTGS is generally available 24x7.
